LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SteelCut.label: class crystal: iron-cleaving form
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SteelCut.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A fighter who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Iron-cleaving form" (circle 6, requires fighter level 11, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (fighter, circle 6): for 30 seconds all attacks ignore armor. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Immovable.label: class crystal: immovable as a mountain
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Immovable.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A fighter who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Immovable as a mountain" (circle 7, requires fighter level 13, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (fighter, circle 7): for 30 seconds, immune to stuns, can't be downed, damage taken ×0.5. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SwordDomain.label: class crystal: sword saint's domain
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SwordDomain.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A fighter who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Sword saint's domain" (circle 8, requires fighter level 15, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (fighter, circle 8): for 20 seconds a sword aura covers 3 cells around you, resolving a melee attack on one enemy in range every 0.5 seconds (using your current melee weapon, damage × martial power). Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Warlord.label: class crystal: lord of armies
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Warlord.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A fighter who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Lord of armies" (circle 9, requires fighter level 17, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (fighter, circle 9): all friendly humanlikes on this map get melee hit +15%, better shooting accuracy, damage dealt ×1.15 and no mental breaks for 1 day. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_CloudStep.label: class crystal: cloud step
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_CloudStep.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A monk who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Cloud step" (circle 6, requires monk level 11, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (monk, Cloud Ascendant, circle 6): leap to any open spot within 25 cells, ignoring walls and terrain; on landing, enemies within radius 2 take 15 × martial power blunt damage and are stunned for 1 second. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_CloudHand.label: class crystal: cloud hand
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_CloudHand.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A monk who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Cloud hand" (circle 7, requires monk level 13, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (monk, Cloud Ascendant, circle 7): strike a 15-cell palm force from afar, 40 × martial power blunt damage, ignoring half the armor and knocking the target back 3 cells. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_CloudBody.label: class crystal: cloud body
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_CloudBody.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A monk who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Cloud body" (circle 8, requires monk level 15, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (monk, Cloud Ascendant, circle 8): movement ×1.3, immune to stuns.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SkyFall.label: class crystal: ninefold heaven strike
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SkyFall.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A monk who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Ninefold heaven strike" (circle 9, requires monk level 17, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (monk, Cloud Ascendant, circle 9): soar into the clouds for 3 seconds (untargetable meanwhile), then plunge to a point within 30 cells: enemies within radius 4 take 60 × martial power blunt damage and are stunned for 5 seconds. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_JudgmentChain.label: class crystal: chains of heaven's punishment
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_JudgmentChain.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A paladin who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Chains of heaven's punishment" (circle 6, requires paladin level 11, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (paladin, circle 6): bind one enemy within 20 cells with holy chains for 10 seconds, leaving it barely able to move; meanwhile each time it attacks it takes 20 × divine power (× psychic sensitivity) holy damage itself. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_RadiantShield.label: class crystal: radiant shield
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_RadiantShield.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A paladin who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Radiant shield" (circle 7, requires paladin level 13, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (paladin, circle 7): after each Divine Smite (or other holy smite-type ability), gain a shield absorbing 30 × divine power damage for 1 minute.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Sanctuary.label: class crystal: sanctuary
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Sanctuary.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A paladin who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Sanctuary" (circle 8, requires paladin level 15, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (paladin, circle 8): mark a sanctuary of radius 5 at a point within 20 cells for 1 hour: allies recover 2 × divine power injury per second, fiends and undead take 5 × divine power holy damage per second. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_AngelDescent.label: class crystal: angelic descent
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_AngelDescent.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A paladin who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Angelic descent" (circle 9, requires paladin level 17, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (paladin, circle 9): summon a celestial angelic attendant (an aasimar, a fine fighter, damage taken ×0.5, melee damage ×1.5) to fight alongside you for 1 day, departing as motes of light when time is up. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_CantripMastery.label: class crystal: conjuration mastery
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_CantripMastery.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A wizard who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Conjuration mastery" (circle 6, requires wizard level 11, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (wizard, circle 6): wizard level 1 abilities cost 0 mana.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_PrismWall.label: class crystal: prismatic wall
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_PrismWall.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A wizard who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Prismatic wall" (circle 7, requires wizard level 13, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (wizard, circle 7): raise a 10-cell-long prismatic wall (perpendicular to the cast direction) at a point within 25 cells for 1 hour: enemies on the wall take fire, frost, lightning and acid damage of 8 × arcane power (× psychic sensitivity) each per second. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Simulacrum.label: class crystal: simulacrum
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Simulacrum.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A wizard who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Simulacrum" (circle 8, requires wizard level 15, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (wizard, circle 8): copy one friendly humanlike within 20 cells out of ice and snow: the simulacrum has the same race, gender and skill levels but only half the toughness (damage taken ×2), and melts after 3 days. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_TruePolymorph.label: class crystal: true polymorph
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_TruePolymorph.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A wizard who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "True polymorph" (circle 9, requires wizard level 17, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (wizard, circle 9): permanently turn one enemy within 20 cells into an animal that belongs to you (big targets become grizzly bears, others timber wolves). No effect on legendary creatures, story bosses and targets of body size 3+. Cooldown 10 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_HolyWordHeal.label: class crystal: holy word healing
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_HolyWordHeal.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A cleric who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Holy word healing" (circle 6, requires cleric level 11, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (cleric, circle 6): Cure Wounds and Mass Cure Wounds also clear one disease or addiction from each person healed.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_DivineWord.label: class crystal: holy word
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_DivineWord.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A cleric who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Holy word" (circle 7, requires cleric level 13, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (cleric, circle 7): speak the holy word of the god; enemies within radius 6: those with under 20% health left die on the spot, under 50% are stunned for 10 seconds, the rest are blinded for 1 minute. Legendary creatures and story bosses are only blinded. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_HolyAura.label: class crystal: holy aura
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_HolyAura.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A cleric who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Holy aura" (circle 8, requires cleric level 15, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (cleric, circle 8): for 1 minute, you and allies within radius 6 take ×0.7 damage, and fiends and undead that attack them in melee are blinded for 10 seconds. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_TrueResurrection.label: class crystal: true resurrection
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_TrueResurrection.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A cleric who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "True resurrection" (circle 9, requires cleric level 17, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (cleric, circle 9): revive a humanlike corpse within 12 cells dead no more than 1 year, regrowing lost limbs and organs too; works even if the corpse has rotted to bones. No effect on liches and necromantic constructs. Cooldown 30 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_TreeStride.label: class crystal: transport via plants
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_TreeStride.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A druid who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Transport via plants" (circle 6, requires druid level 11, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (druid, circle 6): while standing by a tree (within 2 cells), step into it and come out by another tree on this map; up to 3 allies within 2 cells come along. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_RegenCircle.label: class crystal: circle of regeneration
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_RegenCircle.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A druid who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Circle of regeneration" (circle 7, requires druid level 13, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (druid, circle 7): during wild shape, recover 2 × primal power injury every 250 ticks; when returning to human form, heal another 20% of current injuries.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_AnimalShapes.label: class crystal: animal shapes
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_AnimalShapes.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A druid who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Animal shapes" (circle 8, requires druid level 15, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (druid, circle 8): you and up to 4 friendly humanlikes within 5 cells wild shape together (bear form) for 1 hour, with strength based on your primal power. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_DragonForm.label: class crystal: dragon form
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_DragonForm.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A druid who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Dragon form" (circle 9, requires druid level 17, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (druid, circle 9): become a true dragon for 1 hour: dragon claws 30, dragon bite 36 (armor penetration 40%), melee damage × primal power, damage taken ×0.5, movement ×1.3. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SeekingSpell.label: class crystal: metamagic: seeking
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SeekingSpell.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A sorcerer who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Metamagic: seeking" (circle 6, requires sorcerer level 11, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (sorcerer, circle 6): sorcerer spells chase the target's vital spots; damage and healing ×1.25.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_ExtendedSpell.label: class crystal: metamagic: extended
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_ExtendedSpell.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A sorcerer who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Metamagic: extended" (circle 7, requires sorcerer level 13, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (sorcerer, circle 7): sorcerer spell durations ×2.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_ElementalForm.label: class crystal: elemental avatar
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_ElementalForm.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A sorcerer who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Elemental avatar" (circle 8, requires sorcerer level 15, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (sorcerer, circle 8): become an elemental for 30 seconds: immune to fire, frost, lightning, electrical and acid damage, sorcerer spell damage ×1.3. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SourceBurst.label: class crystal: source burst
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SourceBurst.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A sorcerer who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Source burst" (circle 9, requires sorcerer level 17, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (sorcerer, circle 9): spend all your sorcerer mana (at least 1) and detonate it at a point within 25 cells: enemies within radius 5 take (15 per mana point) × innate power (× psychic sensitivity) arcane force damage. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_BloodFury.label: class crystal: blood fury
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_BloodFury.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A barbarian who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Blood fury" (circle 6, requires barbarian level 11, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (barbarian, circle 6): while raging, damage dealt +5% for every 10% of health you've lost (up to +50%).
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Unstoppable.label: class crystal: unstoppable
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Unstoppable.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A barbarian who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Unstoppable" (circle 7, requires barbarian level 13, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (barbarian, circle 7): immune to stuns while raging.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Enlarge.label: class crystal: giant form
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Enlarge.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A barbarian who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Giant form" (circle 8, requires barbarian level 15, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (barbarian, circle 8): your body swells for 30 seconds, melee damage ×1.5, damage taken ×0.8. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_EternalRage.label: class crystal: eternal fury
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_EternalRage.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A barbarian who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Eternal fury" (circle 9, requires barbarian level 17, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (barbarian, circle 9): rage no longer has a time limit and lasts as long as you're still fighting within 10 seconds; can't be downed while raging (you still die from excessive injuries).
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Camouflage.label: class crystal: natural camouflage
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Camouflage.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A ranger who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Natural camouflage" (circle 6, requires ranger level 11, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (ranger, circle 6): after standing still for about 4 seconds while drafted you become camouflaged, and the next attack deals ×2 damage (removed after attacking or moving).
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_GaleArrow.label: class crystal: gale arrow
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_GaleArrow.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A ranger who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Gale arrow" (circle 7, requires ranger level 13, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (ranger, circle 7): fire a ricochet arrow with your current ranged weapon: after hitting the target it bounces to 2 other enemies within 8 cells of it, each a full shot. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_BeastEvolve.label: class crystal: evolved beast companion
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_BeastEvolve.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A ranger who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Evolved beast companion" (circle 8, requires ranger level 15, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (ranger, circle 8): your beast companion takes ×0.67 damage (equivalent to +50% health), melee damage ×1.3, movement ×1.1.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_HuntGodEye.label: class crystal: eye of the hunt god
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_HuntGodEye.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A ranger who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Eye of the hunt god" (circle 9, requires ranger level 17, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (ranger, circle 9): for 1 day, shooting accuracy greatly increased (almost always hits), ×1.5 damage against favored enemies. Cooldown 7 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_TrapMaster.label: class crystal: trap master
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_TrapMaster.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A rogue who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Trap master" (circle 6, requires rogue level 11, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (rogue, circle 6): never triggers any trap.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_CripplingStab.label: class crystal: crippling strike
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_CripplingStab.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A rogue who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Crippling strike" (circle 7, requires rogue level 13, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (rogue, circle 7): after a sneak attack hits, the target's movement ×0.5 for 30 seconds.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_PoisonKing.label: class crystal: poison king
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_PoisonKing.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A rogue who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Poison king" (circle 8, requires rogue level 15, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (rogue, circle 8): Poisoned Blade's poison amount ×2, also works on fleshy undead.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Shadowless.label: class crystal: shadowless
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Shadowless.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A rogue who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Shadowless" (circle 9, requires rogue level 17, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (rogue, circle 9): turn invisible for 3 seconds after each kill; can trigger repeatedly.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_OtherGuardian.label: class crystal: otherworldly guardian
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_OtherGuardian.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A warlock who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Otherworldly guardian" (circle 6, requires warlock level 11, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (warlock, circle 6): summon an otherworldly guardian based on your patron to fight alongside you for 3 days: an imp for the Fiend, a sprite for the Archfey, a quasit otherwise. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SoulHarvest.label: class crystal: soul harvest
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SoulHarvest.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A warlock who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Soul harvest" (circle 7, requires warlock level 13, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (warlock, circle 7): killing an enemy with eldritch damage (eldritch blast etc.) restores 1 pact mana.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_MassFear.label: class crystal: mass fear
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_MassFear.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A warlock who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Mass fear" (circle 8, requires warlock level 15, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (warlock, circle 8): enemies within radius 6 at a point within 20 cells are terrified and scatter for 15 seconds; legendary creatures and story bosses have a 50% chance to break free. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SoulPact.label: class crystal: soul pact
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_SoulPact.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A warlock who absorbs it permanently learns the passive arcanum "Soul pact" (circle 9, requires warlock level 17, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum passive (warlock, circle 9): hostile humanlikes you kill (except legendary creatures and story bosses) have a 50% chance to have their soul bound: they rise on the spot as your combat thrall, and after 3 days the soul disperses and they vanish as motes of light.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_IrresistibleDance.label: class crystal: irresistible dance
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_IrresistibleDance.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A bard who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Irresistible dance" (circle 6, requires bard level 11, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (bard, circle 6): one enemy within 15 cells is forced to dance for 20 seconds × inspiration power: can't attack or walk away, damage taken ×1.3. Success = 65% + (inspiration power - 1) × 40%, -5% per point of the target's Wisdom modifier, also offset by mind resistance; story bosses and legendary units dance 5 seconds at most. No effect on mechanoids. Cooldown 2 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_MassInvisibility.label: class crystal: mass invisibility
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_MassInvisibility.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A bard who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Mass invisibility" (circle 7, requires bard level 13, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (bard, circle 7): all friendly humanlikes within 10 cells (including yourself) turn invisible for 30 seconds; attacking or casting reveals them. Cooldown 3 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_PowerWordStun.label: class crystal: power word stun
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_PowerWordStun.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A bard who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Power word stun" (circle 8, requires bard level 15, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (bard, circle 8): all enemies within radius 5 at a point within 20 cells are stunned for 6 seconds × inspiration power; half the time for story bosses and legendary units. Works on mechanoids too. Cooldown 5 days.
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Foresight.label: class crystal: foresight
LanguageData.LP_Crystal_Foresight.description: A Mana Lake class crystal. A bard who absorbs it permanently learns the arcanum "Foresight" (circle 9, requires bard level 17, takes 1 arcanum slot; there is 1 arcanum slot each at adventurer levels 11 / 15 / 20 and legend level 30).\n\nArcanum (bard, circle 9): one ally (can be yourself) sees a moment into the future for 1 day: melee hit +25%, better shooting accuracy, melee dodge +25%, mind resistance +50%, can't be ambushed. Cooldown 7 days.
